name: Avilla (United States)
description: White field between two navy blue vertical stripes at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with a navy blue star bearing the town seal, EST. 1876 and the motto OUR HOME IS YOURS; the blue stripes carry white silhouettes of a scroll, a barn, a map of Indiana and a family.
history: Avilla is a town in Allen Township, Noble County, in Indiana. The flag was adopted on 19 December 2007, according to Flags of the World.

features.role: map of Indiana and family silhouettes
